known_caveats: Re-measured on PR dcwalker/ai-skills#97 with no change to the writing skill. Trials launched from a Claude Code session inherited CLAUDE_CODE_USER_EMAIL and related variables, which put the email in the model's context and made trials reject fixture personas' cached profiles. The harness now unsets them; the previous baseline may have been recorded with that leak, and this run is the first known to be without it.
Graded strictly and literally, the same standard as the 2026-09-28 baseline.
One run per eval, so single-eval results are noisy: the same revision's per-run pass rate varied by about 10 points across repeated runs.
wordfreq was NOT available (no WRITING_STYLE_VENV), so keyness and the rarity check were skipped. The 2026-09-28 baseline ran with them.
Trial workspaces were outside the repo (TRIALS_DIR), so the repo's AGENTS.md did not apply to trials.
